topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: Got a tip about your little side project? Thought you were the only one with the bright idea, huh? Turns out the patent office already heard the same tale. Someone beat you to the punch, stepped on your shadow. It's a tough city, and it's even tougher playing by the books. But listen, don't you go losing your grip. I've seen plenty of dreams get watered down in this town, but sometimes, there's a silver lining hidden in the rain. Maybe this is your chance to take a step back, rethink, and come back even stronger. This ain’t the end. It’s a detour, maybe a roadblock, but it don’t change the fact that you got what it takes to keep on driving. Keep your head up, and let’s figure this out together.
